india.one_line: India sees major AI infrastructure investment, startup funding, defence partnership, and new venture fund.

themes.title: Tata Communications builds AI network
themes.text: Tata Communications will invest up to $450 million to build a 10,000 km high‑speed fibre network linking AI data‑centre corridors, starting with the Mumbai‑Pune‑Hyderabad‑Chennai route, targeting hyperscalers, AI platforms and enterprises.

stories.headline: Tata Communications to invest $450 million in 10,000 km AI network in India
Tata Communications to spend $450 million on 10,000 km AI‑ready fibre network in India

themes.title: Nvidia backs Simplismart GPU cost cut
themes.text: Nvidia led a $14 million Series B round valuing Simplismart at about $100 million, and the startup’s software helped InVideo reduce GPU serving costs by 56%.

stories.headline: Nvidia backs Indian startup Simplismart with $14 million to cut AI GPU costs

themes.title: Unacademy founders launch AI deeptech fund
themes.text: Unacademy co‑founders Gaurav Munjal and Roman Saini are raising a ₹700 crore fund, Longshot Capital, to invest $500,000‑$1.5 million in 25‑28 seed and pre‑Series A AI and deep‑tech startups, with the first close planned for January 2027.

stories.headline: Unacademy founders launch ₹700 cr AI and deeptech fund Longshot Capital

themes.title: Defence ministry partners with Sarvam AI
themes.text: India’s Ministry of Defence signed a five‑year MoU with Sarvam AI to develop and deploy AI applications for the Army, Navy and Air Force, covering decision support, target acquisition and data fusion, while retaining human oversight.

stories.headline: India's Ministry of Defence signs AI partnership with Sarvam
